# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 12 sr-route1, Restoration and Hegemony (the strong route), batch 1. Generated by gen_strong_route.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================================================================== the month (scheduler row 33)
# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 33); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. The count runs in January and in the first month the line runs (a new game and an old save
# alike); then at most one event a month.
oe_sr_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_init } }
        set_variable = oe_sr_init
        oe_sr_year = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_month = 1 }
        oe_sr_year = yes
    }
    # batch 3: the campaign routes (S2) come after .1, .3 and .2 and never in the same month as one of them
    oe_sr_hc_scan = yes
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_has_due = yes OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_pick } AND = { has_variable = oe_sr_pick_until var:oe_sr_pick_until < oe_ml_month_now } } } set_variable = oe_sr_busy }
    oe_sr_dispatch = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_busy } } oe_sr_dispatch_hc = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_busy
}
# BYZ scope. The yearly round: count, stage, rungs.
oe_sr_year = {
    oe_sr_count_regions = yes
    oe_sr_set_tier = yes
    oe_sr_check_rungs = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_sr_hooks_in
}

# ======================================================================== the count (G1, G2)
# Location scope; $r$ = the region of this location. One location of the explicit list: the empire's own land, or a
# subject's (oe_heg_byz_bloc without the empire itself).
oe_sr_cnt = {
    if = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_sr_n_$r$ add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_sr_own_n add = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { owner ?= { is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ } }
        c:BYZ = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_sr_n_$r$ add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_sr_sub_n add = 1 }
        }
    }
}

    # 1 the capital district: only whether the bloc holds its centre (the stages ask for Constantinople itself)
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_s_1 value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= { oe_sr_bloc = yes } } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_s_1 value = 1 } }
    # 2 Thrace–Macedonia: 8 of 15 locations and the centre edirne
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_sr_n_2 >= 8 location:edirne = { owner ?= { oe_sr_bloc = yes } } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_s_2 value = 2 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_sr_back_n add = 1 }
        location:edirne = { set_variable = oe_sr_back }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_s_2 value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:edirne = { owner ?= { oe_sr_bloc = yes } } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_s_2 value = 1 } }
        location:edirne = { remove_variable = oe_sr_back }
    }
    # 3 Philippopolis–Rhodope: 7 of 13 locations and the centre plovdiv

    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_27 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc6 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_29 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc6 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_30 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc6 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_31 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc6 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_32 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc6 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_33 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc6 add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc7 value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_34 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc7 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_37 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc7 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_28 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc7 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_36 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc7 add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc8 value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_15 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc8 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_19 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc8 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_20 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc8 add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_s_38 = 2 } change_variable = { name = oe_sr_rc8 add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_ms_byz value = c:BYZ.military_strength }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_ms_tur value = c:TUR.military_strength } }
    else = { remove_variable = oe_sr_ms_tur }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_count_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
}

# ======================================================================== the stage (design 3.2)
# BYZ scope. Stages rise only, except 2 -> 1; a test stage (oe_sr_test_tier, buttons srt1-srt3) is used as it is.
oe_sr_set_tier = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_sr_test_tier }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = var:oe_sr_test_tier }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_sr_tier = 2 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { oe_sr_has_city = yes } }
                oe_sr_fall = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:oe_sr_back_n < 10 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_low } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_low value = 0 } }
                change_variable = { name = oe_sr_low add = 1 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_low >= 2 } oe_sr_fall = yes }
            }
            else = { remove_variable = oe_sr_low }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 4 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_sr_tier < 3 oe_sr_t3_ok = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 3 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_sr_tier < 2 oe_sr_t2_ok = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sr_fell } set_variable = oe_sr_revived }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_sr_tier < 1 oe_sr_t1_ok = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 1 }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_tier >= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_fired_1 } } set_variable = oe_sr_due_1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_tier >= 2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_fired_3 } } set_variable = oe_sr_due_3 }
}
# BYZ scope. 2 -> 1 (oe_sr_fell counts the falls; the chronicle tells it).
oe_sr_fall = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 1 }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_low
    remove_variable = oe_sr_revived
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_fell } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fell value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_sr_fell add = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. A rung that is open (1) and met becomes due (2); its event is sent later (then 3).
oe_sr_check_rungs = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r1 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_1_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r2 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_2_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r3 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_3_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r4 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_4_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r5 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_5_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r6 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_6_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r7 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_7_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r8 ?= 1 oe_sr_rung_8_ok = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r8 value = 2 } }
}

# ======================================================================== sending (design 3.5)
# BYZ scope, monthly. One event at most a month, in the order .1, .3, .2; each waits for the lock at most 6 months.
# While a .2 has not been answered (oe_sr_pick is set) nothing else is sent, so that its options act on its own rung;
# after 12 months without an answer the mark is dropped.
oe_sr_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_sr_pick has_variable = oe_sr_pick_until var:oe_sr_pick_until < oe_ml_month_now }
        remove_variable = oe_sr_pick
        remove_variable = oe_sr_pick_until
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sr_has_due = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_pick } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_wait } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_wait value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_sr_wait add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_sr_wait >= 6 } }
            remove_variable = oe_sr_wait
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sr_due_1 } oe_sr_send_1 = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sr_due_3 } oe_sr_send_3 = yes }
            else = {
                if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r1 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 1 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r2 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 2 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r3 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 3 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r4 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 4 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r5 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 5 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r6 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 6 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r7 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 7 } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_r8 ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = 8 } }
                oe_sr_send_2 = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_sr.1 (the test button sre1 runs it as well).
oe_sr_send_1 = {
    remove_variable = oe_sr_due_1
    set_variable = oe_sr_fired_1
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.1
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_sr.3: the year for the chronicle, the month for later lines.
oe_sr_send_3 = {
    remove_variable = oe_sr_due_3
    set_variable = oe_sr_fired_3
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_sr_strong_y value = current_year }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_since2 value = oe_ml_month_now }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.3
}

        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_tmp value = oe_sr_sparse_33 }

    }

        if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_fs_tmp > var:oe_sr_fs_n location:sivas = { oe_fs_center_ok = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_n value = var:oe_sr_fs_tmp } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_reg value = 34 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_at value = location:sivas } }

    }

        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_tmp value = oe_sr_sparse_38 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_fs_tmp > var:oe_sr_fs_n location:nicosia_cyp = { oe_fs_center_ok = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_n value = var:oe_sr_fs_tmp } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_reg value = 38 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_at value = location:nicosia_cyp } }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_fs_tmp

    }

    change_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick_until add = 12 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.2
}

# ======================================================================== the worker oe_sr.90 (design 3.4)
# BYZ scope. Imperial Authority on the Pillars (the form of oe_fs_auth_add).
oe_sr_auth_add = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority }
            change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. oe_sr_job: 11-14 oe_sr.1 a-d; 21-23 oe_sr.2 a-c; 31-33 oe_sr.3 a-c; 99 clear the line (test).
oe_sr_work = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_sr_job >= 11 var:oe_sr_job <= 14 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_job = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_emph value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_job = 12 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_emph value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_job = 13 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_emph value = 3 } }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_sr_emph value = 0 }
            oe_sr_auth_add = { amount = 2 }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_r1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r1 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_r2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_r2 value = 1 } }

# ======================================================================== batch 2 (sr-route2)
# BYZ scope. .2 d: open a frontier programme in the region the sender picked (gen_frontier.py's oe_fs_prog_open, free of
# charge; it checks itself and counts oe_fs_a_n when it opens). Within the emphasis the rung's land also gains
# oe_sr_old_land (one step higher). Not opened after all (the programme's slots filled meanwhile): option c's reward.
oe_sr_do_fs = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_was value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_a_n } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_fs_was value = var:oe_fs_a_n } }
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_fs_ok = yes } var:oe_sr_fs_at ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_open_c } oe_fs_prog_open = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_a_n var:oe_fs_a_n > var:oe_sr_fs_was }
        if = { limit = { oe_sr_pick_in_emph = yes } oe_sr_do_land = yes }
    }
    else = { oe_sr_do_land = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_fs_was
}

# BYZ scope; $part$: 1 part A of the Thessalonica line (the second court's blockade), 2 part D (the later blockade).
# THE entry of the Thessalonica hook (gen_thessalonica.py): called instead of that line's surrender when the city is
# encircled, its resolve is spent and oe_sr_ths_roll_ok holds; that line keeps its own pending mark meanwhile. Sends
# oe_sr.5 once; nothing while one is open.
oe_sr_ths_offer = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_ths_part } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_ths_part value = $part$ }
        remove_variable = oe_sr_ths_res
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.5
    }
}
# BYZ scope. oe_sr.5 a (job 51, the roll: oe_sr_ths_chance; srroll0 / srroll1 fix it once through oe_sr_roll_force:
# 1 fails, 2 holds) and b (job 52, yield). Held: the Thessalonica line's part ends as "held" (its own effects and
# marks), prestige +10. Lost or yielded: that line's own surrender runs (the city goes to the Ottomans while they
# encircle it, else it pays a harac); lost after the roll: stability -7; yielded in part A: prestige -10 (as its
# own .5 a). oe_sr_ths_res: 1 held, 2 lost and handed over, 3 lost but a harac, 4 yielded and handed over, 5 yielded
# but a harac. Then the notice oe_sr.6.
oe_sr_ths_do = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_roll value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_sr_job = 51 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_roll_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_roll value = 1 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_roll_force } }
            random = { chance = oe_sr_ths_chance set_variable = { name = oe_sr_roll value = 1 } }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_sr_roll_force
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_sr_roll = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_sr_ths_part = 1 }
            set_global_variable = oe_ths_held_1387
            oe_ths_theme_loy = { amount = 5 }
            oe_ths_a_end = { why = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = oe_ths_d_held
            oe_ths_d_end = { why = 4 }
        }
        add_prestige = 10
        set_global_variable = oe_sr_ths_held
        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_ths_res value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_ths_part = 1 } oe_ths_1387 = yes }
        else = { oe_ths_d_outcome = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sr_ths_res value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_ths_res value = 3 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_sr_job = 51 }
            add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
        }
        else = {
            change_variable = { name = oe_sr_ths_res add = 2 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_ths_part = 1 } add_prestige = -10 }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_roll
    remove_variable = oe_sr_ths_part
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.6
}

# ======================================================================== batch 3 (sr-route3): S2, the first four routes
# BYZ scope, monthly. A newly won campaign (victory or negotiated peace: the campaign line's oe_hc_<r>_won) becomes due.
oe_sr_hc_scan = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_won NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_hc_egypt } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_egypt value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_won NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_hc_italy } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_italy value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_won NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_hc_persia } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_persia value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_won NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_hc_blacksea } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_blacksea value = 1 } }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly, only in a month in which .1, .3 and .2 send nothing: one route's event at most, in the order
# Egypt, Italy, Persia, the Black Sea; waits for the lock at most 6 months.
oe_sr_dispatch_hc = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_sr_hc_due = yes }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_wait_hc } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_wait_hc value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_sr_wait_hc add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_sr_wait_hc >= 6 } }
            remove_variable = oe_sr_wait_hc
            if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_hc_egypt ?= 1 } oe_sr_send_21 = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_hc_italy ?= 1 } oe_sr_send_23 = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_hc_persia ?= 1 } oe_sr_send_27 = yes }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_sr_hc_blacksea ?= 1 } oe_sr_send_28 = yes }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_sr.21 (Egypt; the test button srw21 runs it too): the goal place and the numbers the
# options show are stored, then the event.
oe_sr_send_21 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_egypt value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_egypt value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_goal_egypt = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_egypt value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_eg_n value = 0 }
    every_owned_location = { limit = { oe_hc_egypt_location = yes } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_sr_eg_n add = 1 } } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.21
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_sr.23 (Italy; the test button srw23 runs it too): the goal place and the numbers the
# options show are stored, then the event.
oe_sr_send_23 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_italy value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_italy value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_goal_italy = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_italy value = 1 } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.23
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_sr.27 (Persia; the test button srw27 runs it too): the goal place and the numbers the
# options show are stored, then the event.
oe_sr_send_27 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_persia value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_persia value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_goal_persia = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_persia value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pe_n value = 0 }
    every_country = { limit = { oe_sr_persian_ruler = yes } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_sr_pe_n add = 1 } } }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.27
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_sr.28 (the Black Sea; the test button srw28 runs it too): the goal place and the numbers the
# options show are stored, then the event.
oe_sr_send_28 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_blacksea value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_blacksea value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_goal_blacksea = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hg_blacksea value = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_bs_amt value = oe_sr_bs_amount }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.28
}

# BYZ scope. Count now (srnow), whatever the month.
oe_sr_test_now = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_init } } set_variable = oe_sr_init }
    oe_sr_year = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Force stage $t$ (srt1-srt3), then count at once.
oe_sr_test_force = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_test_tier value = $t$ }
    oe_sr_test_now = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Stop forcing (srt0): the stage is computed again from 0 (marks of events already sent stay).
oe_sr_test_unforce = {
    remove_variable = oe_sr_test_tier
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_tier value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_low
    oe_sr_test_now = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Send .1 now (sre1).
oe_sr_test_e1 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_back_n } } oe_sr_test_now = yes }
    oe_sr_send_1 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Send .2 for rung $k$ now (sre2, sre2x), met or not.
oe_sr_test_e2 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_back_n } } oe_sr_test_now = yes }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_pick value = $k$ }
    oe_sr_send_2 = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Send .3 now (sre3).
oe_sr_test_e3 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_back_n } } oe_sr_test_now = yes }
    oe_sr_send_3 = yes
}
# ---- batch 2 test helpers
# BYZ scope. Send oe_sr.4 now (srem): as the Pillars card does, without its conditions (no emphasis yet counts as none).
oe_sr_test_e4 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sr_emph } } set_variable = { name = oe_sr_emph value = 0 } }
    remove_variable = oe_sr_emph_changed
    set_variable = oe_sr_emph_open
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sr.4
}
# BYZ scope. Offer the defence roll of Thessaloniki now (srth1, srth2), whatever the Thessalonica line is doing.
oe_sr_test_ths = {
    remove_variable = oe_sr_ths_part
    oe_sr_ths_offer = { part = $part$ }
}
# BYZ scope. The next roll of oe_sr.5 a holds ($r$ = 2, srroll1) or fails ($r$ = 1, srroll0), once.
oe_sr_test_roll = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_roll_force value = $r$ }
}
# ---- batch 3 test helpers
# BYZ scope. Mark the four routes as won and due (srwall): the monthly round then sends one event a month.
oe_sr_test_hc_all = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_egypt value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_italy value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_persia value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_hc_blacksea value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. The goal places count as held ($g$ = 1, srg1) or not held ($g$ = 2, srg2) when a route's event is sent next.
oe_sr_test_goal_set = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_sr_test_goal value = $g$ }
}
# BYZ scope. The goal places are read from the map again (srg0).
oe_sr_test_goal_off = {
    remove_variable = oe_sr_test_goal
}
